statement: ∀ (x : YEuclid n), (∀ t : ℝ, yHoriz (yJoin x t) = x ∧ yVert (yJoin x t) = t) ∧ Isometry (fun t : ℝ => yJoin x t)
proof:
intro x
constructor
· intro t
  constructor
  · ext i
    simp [yHoriz, yJoin]
  · simp [yVert, yJoin]
· apply Isometry.of_dist_eq
  intro t u
  have hsq : dist (yJoin x t) (yJoin x u) ^ 2 = dist t u ^ 2 := by
    rw [PiLp.dist_sq_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    simp [yJoin]
  nlinarith [dist_nonneg (x := yJoin x t) (y := yJoin x u), dist_nonneg (x := t) (y := u)]
